name: Glaucous-Reach
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, towering mountain ranges emerge like the bones of the planet.
Toxic air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Debris from the escape pod debris field rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
